title: ChooseMyStat: An interactive statistical analysis advisor for clinical researchers
description:
ChooseMyStat is an interactive web application that guides postgraduate medical residents and clinical researchers through choosing appropriate descriptive summaries, inferential tests, diagnostic accuracy and agreement/reliability analyses, and sample size calculations for their studies.

For each recommendation it provides a Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP) template paragraph (ASA 2016 effect-first and traditional styles), a results-reporting example, point-and-click instructions for JASP, and R code (tidyverse, gtsummary, effectsize and related packages). Recommendations can be compiled into a consolidated analysis plan and exported as text, Markdown or an R script.

Developed at the Clinical Epidemiology Unit, All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS) Bhopal, with assistance from Claude (Anthropic), an AI assistant.
